42426-gold-elsie.creator: Mrs. A. L. Wister.
42426-gold-elsie.description: A book by Mrs. A. L. Wister.. blond and black scalps, stared out upon the passers-by. Smiling shopmen displayed their fascinating merchandise, and withered old flower-sellers stood among their fresh-blooming bouquets, which exhaled beauty and fragrance beneath the light of the lamps that shed a brilliant glare upon the slippery pavement and upon the flood of human life streaming by, revealing the pinched, blue features and the desperately uncomfortable movements of all, old and young.

arxiv-2101-04758.title: Self-Training Pre-Trained Language Models for Zero- and Few-Shot Multi-Dialectal Arabic Sequence Labeling
arxiv-2101-04758.creator: Muhammad Khalifa 1, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed 2, Khaled Shaalan 3
arxiv-2101-04758.description: Abstract A sufficient amount of annotated data is usually required to fine-tune pre-trained language models for downstream tasks. Unfortunately, attaining labeled data can be costly, especially for multiple language varieties and dialects. We propose to self-train pre-trained language models in zero- and few-shot scenarios to improve performance on data-scarce varieties using only resources from data-rich ones.

arxiv-2109-11662.title: Constraining Time Dependent Dark Matter Signals from the Sun
arxiv-2109-11662.creator: Yu-Feng Zhou
arxiv-2109-11662.description: Abstract Dark matter (DM) particles captured by the Sun can produce high-energy electrons outside the Sun through annihilating into meta-stable mediators. The corresponding cosmic-ray electron signals observed by the space-based experiments will be time dependent due to the orbital motion of the space-based detectors. The shape of this time dependence is predictable given the orbital information of the detectors.

arxiv-2509-09524.title: DeMeVa at LeWiDi-2025: Modeling Perspectives with In-Context Learning and Label Distribution Learning
arxiv-2509-09524.creator: Daniil Ignatev, Nan Li, Hugh Mee Wong, Anh Dang, Shane Kaszefski Yaschuk
arxiv-2509-09524.description: Abstract This system paper presents the DeMeVa team’s approaches to the third edition of the Learning with Disagreements shared task ( Leonardelli et al. 2025 , LeWiDi 2025;) . We explore two directions: in-context learning (ICL) with large language models, where we compare example sampling strategies; and label distribution learning (LDL) methods with RoBERTa Liu et al.

arxiv-2510-19530.title: Optimizing the Unknown: Black Box Bayesian Optimization with Energy-Based Model and Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2510-19530.creator: Ruiyao Miao, Junren Xiao, Shiya Tsang, Hui Xiong, Yingnian Wu
arxiv-2510-19530.description: Abstract Existing Bayesian Optimization (BO) methods typically balance exploration and exploitation to optimize costly objective functions. However, these methods often suffer from a significant one-step bias, which may lead to convergence towards local optima and poor performance in complex or high-dimensional tasks.

pmc-10509008.title: Assessing the effects of a drought experiment on the reproductive phenology and ecophysiology of a wet tropical rainforest community
pmc-10509008.creator: Nara Vogado, Susan G Laurance, Michael J Liddell, Jayden E Engert, Christopher M Wurster, Michele Schiffer, Andrew Thompson, Cassandra Nichols, Lucas A Cernusak
pmc-10509008.description: In this study we assessed the effects of an experimental drought on the reproductive phenology and ecophysiology of a rainforest tree community in the Wet Tropics of Queensland. We found that, although the drought increased fruiting activity in the community relative to the reference plot, species-level response was varied in both phenology and physiology.

pmc-11314629.title: Carbonized Ganoderma Lucidum/V2O3 Composites as a Superior Cathode for High-Performance Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
pmc-11314629.creator: Guilin Zeng, Zhengda Li, Shaohua Jiang, Wei Zhou, Jian Peng, Wei Zhang
pmc-11314629.description: In response to the suboptimal electrochemical performance of low-valence vanadium oxides, Ganoderma lucidum biomass-derived carbon@V2O3 (V2O3@CGL) composites were prepared by evaporative self-assembly technology and high-temperature calcination. In the prepared composites, V2O3 effectively encapsulates CGL, serving as a support for V2O3 and enhancing electrical conductivity and structural stability. This results in improved overall performance for the composites.

pmc-11335761.title: Effects of apelin on neonatal brain neurogenesis in L-NAME-induced maternal preeclampsia
pmc-11335761.creator: Canberk Tomruk, Cansın Şirin Tomruk, Burcu Denizlioğlu, Murat Olukman, Gülinnaz Ercan, Soner Duman, Timur Köse, Emel Öykü Çetin Uyanıkgil, Yiğit Uyanıkgil, Ayşegül Uysal
pmc-11335761.description: The aim of this study was to investigate the possible protective effects of apelin, which is known to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, on changes in neurogenesis in newborns of pregnant rats with L-NAME-induced preeclampsia. Wistar albino female rats were divided into four experimental groups: Control, Apelin, Preeclampsia and Preeclampsia + Apelin.

pmc-11369108.title: Prevalence and risk factors for overactive bladder symptoms in patients with artificial urinary sphincter
pmc-11369108.creator: Hisanori Taniguchi, Nae Takizawa, Hidefumi Kinoshita
pmc-11369108.description: To demonstrate the prevalence and risk factors for overactive bladder symptoms associated with artificial urinary sphincter implantation, we investigated the patients who underwent primary artificial urinary sphincter implantation with severe urinary stress incontinence. Forty-eight patients who completely answered the questionnaires of the overactive bladder symptom score before surgery were included.

pmc-11676688.title: Multiscale Concurrent Topology Optimization and Mechanical Property Analysis of Sandwich Structures
pmc-11676688.creator: Zihao Li, Shiqiang Li, Zhihua Wang, Antonio Santagata
pmc-11676688.description: Based on the basic theoretical framework of the Bi-directional Evolutionary Structural Optimization method (BESO) and the Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization method (SIMP), this paper presents a multiscale topology optimization method for concurrently optimizing the sandwich structure at the macro level and the core layer at the micro level.

pmc-11710302.title: A new pipeline for converting neuroimaging data into computational models of ISF/CSF processes
pmc-11710302.creator: Donald L. Elbert
pmc-11710302.description: BackgroundA multitude of high‐quality imaging modalities exist that provide structural data at unprecedented levels of detail. Tissue ultrastructure greatly influences the rate of transport of proteins and other molecules that contribute to neurodegeneration. However, our ability to model flow and diffusion processes in the brain lags behind the quality of the neuroimaging data.

pmc-13072565.title: Genetically predicted inflammatory cytokines mediate the associations between the gut microbiota and ovarian cancer: a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization study
pmc-13072565.creator: Lili Chuan, Bo Yao, Haiming Zhang, Shasha Luo, Guangliang Lu, Ying Wu, Yanping Ren
pmc-13072565.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOvarian cancer (OC), the deadliest gynecologic malignancy, lacks effective strategies for early detection and treatment. Emerging evidence suggests that the gut microbiota and inflammatory cytokines may influence OC pathogenesis, but the causal mechanisms remain unclear. This study employed a bidirectional, two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis with genetic mediation analysis to investigate whether genetically predicted inflammatory cytokines mediate the associations between the gut microbiota and OC.MethodsThis study was based on an analysis of public genetic summary statistics from predominantly European populations.

pmc-13367526.title: Whole blood storage time impairs clot strength with minimal change in functional fibrinogen concentration
pmc-13367526.creator: Elizabeth R. Maginot, Nicolle K. Barmettler, Flobater I. Gawargi, Collin M. White, Natasha Goodman, Timothy R. Billiar, Refael Munitz, Scott A. Koepsell, Shelly M. Williams, Aleh Bobr, Phillip C. Spinella, Susan M. Shea, Reynold Henry, Christopher D. Barrett
pmc-13367526.description: Background:Whole blood (WB) is a preferred resuscitation strategy, yet how storage affects hemostasis remains unclear. Prior studies have shown decreased fibrinogen function during storage; however, these were limited by incomplete removal of platelet contributions. Additionally, leukoreduced (LR) versus non-leukoreduced (NLR) status in preserving fibrinogen remains unknown.
